locator.text: Display 87.3, p. 87, in the statement of Corollary 7.8

evidence: paper: U = W_0^{\mathrm{as}} + E, \qquad U \in \mathsf{W}_{1/2}, \qquad E \in \mathsf{W}_{\rho}.

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Same hypothesis, encoded as two coefficient-class fields plus a difference block rather than as one equation. (i) Class membership: by the paper's own Definition 6.5 (p70, 'Then w ∈ Wα means that every Aγ,m belongs to Wα, with the uniform bounds in (6.29)'), 'U ∈ W_{1/2}' is a bound on the grouped label-harmonic amplitudes; Lean's `old.WaveBounds s P α` (CorrectionState.lean:192) is exactly that — `∀ i (j : ℤ), j ≠ 0 → WaveClass s P α (b.velocity n i j)` — with `WaveClass` the ε^α·√ζ·P weighted all-order class (WeightedClasses.lean:118). The label-indexed form is `UniformWaveClass` in `SignedFamily.old_bounds`. (ii) The decomposition: Lean never writes `old = primary + E`. It takes `primary` and `old` as separate blocks on a common carrier (`hop : SameCarrier old primary`) and assumes the class bound on `subBlock old primary`, whose velocity coefficients are `old.velocity - primary.velocity`; `subBlock_oscillation` (CorrectionStep.lean:2329) gives `(subBlock old primary).oscillation = old.oscillation - primary.oscillation`, so E := U - W_0^as and `U = W_0^as + E` holds identically. The rewriting is therefore the substitution E := old - primary, and it is the one Lean actually performs: `signedRemainder_exact` (LabelSumBounds.lean:802) rewrites the remainder as `symmetricCovariance (old - primary) tangent + symmetricCovariance old curl + bilinearCovariance (tangent+curl) (tangent+curl)`, i.e. the paper's B(E, L^as Σ) + B(U, R) + C(V). (iii) Exponents: the paper fixes U ∈ W_{1/2} and leaves ρ free; Lean leaves both free (α for U, δ for E), so on this clause Lean is more general, and it is instantiated at literally α = 1/2, δ = 17/25 in `signed_tensor_bounds` (SignedMeanGain.lean:462). No constant, sign, harmonic restriction (j ≠ 0 on both sides) or weight differs.
